The Un-Official 'Don't Taze Me Bro' Rod of Divine Justice
Piece:  Weapon
Type:  Rainbow Item

The Un-Official 'Don't Taze Me Bro' Rod of Divine Justice is a mage rainbow item.

This item is soulbound.

Attributes:

The base item always carries:

  • + Divine Damage
  • + % Casting Speed

Rolled copies can also pick up an extra ending. Those endings and their bonuses are listed on Mythic Suffixes.
